Expanding the toggle reveals insights-pages, insights-forms, insights-sources, insights-best. Clicking inbox-archive-test-btn shows the Sonner toast 'No test leads older than 30 days' and refreshes counts. Weekly summary card also renders with '3 lead(s), 0 hot' confirming test-lane exclusion. No regressions observed on Real/Test/Archived tabs, priority/review sections or booking-invite button.
critical_code_review_comments: inbox.py booking-invite: if wf['send_email'] is missing (no key), invite.to stays None but the response still returns 200 with an empty copies list. Consider raising 503 in that case so the UI surfaces the state, or hydrate invite.to from msg.from_email even when the send integration is absent — the endpoint's contract is 'sent invite' but preview-mode with no key would silently record an invite dict with to=None.
inbox.py cron_archive_test_leads returns run_id from X-Webhook-Id header — if the header is missing run_id will be None. Consider generating a uuid fallback so log correlation always works.

inbox.py _archive_stale_test uses ISO-string comparison for created_at/updated_at cutoff. This works today because all timestamps are stored as ISO-8601 UTC strings, but a lead written with a non-Z / offset-suffixed string would sort incorrectly. Consider migrating to real BSON dates or adding a timezone-normalized index.
